text:
megan_se: Quick sync — Orchid Health POC cutover timeline. Need clarity on who owns the staging cutover window, network certs, and webhook schema. Can we lock the ETA for next-week dry run?
priya_pm: I can own coordination. Quick Q: are we still aiming for Wed 09:00 PT for the dry run? that was the ask from the customer.
ramon_eng: Wed morning works for infra side but two deps: 1) whitelist IPs from Orchid (they'll give list by EOD today), 2) TLS certs for staging.redwood-orchid (adrian_sre owning cert deploy).
mei_se: I'll confirm with Orchid on IPs and provide sample payloads. Also remind them success criteria: end-to-end inference <300ms p50, no auth errors, and 2000 sample records processed in 30 mins.
adrian_sre: I will handle certs. ETA: certs generated + staged by Tue 18:00 PT if DNS for staging host is in place. Need DNS ticket from networking.
megan_se: great — @adrian_sre can you post the DNS ticket id here once created? priya will track customer-side ops.
priya_pm: logging that action items: 1) Orchid to provide IP whitelist (Orchid) 2) DNS ticket (eng-network) 3) Cert deploy (adrian_sre) 4) Webhook schema + sample data (mei_se & Orchid) 5) Load test script and target (ramon_eng). I'll update the POC timeline doc after this thread.
ramon_eng: load test plan: run 2k requests over 30m with 1 concurrent agent, TTL=20s, KV cache warm. Will share the k6 script:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){
  http.post('https://staging-api.redwood/orchid/v1/infer', JSON.stringify({input: 'test'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
megan_se: nice, thanks. Mei — when can you drop the webhook JSON schema? even a rough draft helps the eng team.
mei_se: drafting now, will post sample payload by EOD. main fields: user_id, request_id, model_version, input_text, metadata.{source,patient_id}, sig header. Also will include a small invalid-case set.
adrian_sre: DNS ticket created: #NET-4127. I linked it to staging host and requested expedited. cert plan unchanged.
megan_se: perfect. Two more checks: 1) Who will run the dry-run? (SE + Eng oncall?) 2) Post-mortem acceptance criteria owner?
priya_pm: For the run, propose: Mei + Ramon + Adrian + Alex (oncall) + megan for customer-facing. Post-mortem + acceptance: I'll own the doc and Mei will validate payload correctness.
adrian_sre: I'll coordinate with oncall for the cutover slot and set a pre-check at T-30m for certs and routing.
priya_pm: timeline summary I will paste into the POC tracker: dry run Wed 09:00 PT; pre-check Tue 17:30 PT; cert staging Tue 18:00 PT; Orchid IPs by EOD today; sample payloads by EOD.
megan_se: thanks everyone — if Orchid confirms IPs today we’re green. @deploy-bot can you schedule the dry-run reminder 24h and 1h prior?
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run (Orchid POC) Wed 09:00 PT — notifications at Tue 09:00 PT and Wed 08:00 PT :bell:
ramon_eng: one last note — if we hit unexpected latency, fallback plan is to route to a quantized v2 model in the same pool. I will prepare the fallback config and a quick rollback command.
megan_se: awesome. I'll follow up with a quick status ping tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
